name: Theme Toggle
description: An icon button that toggles the dark class on the document root and reports its state.

anatomy.description: The icon button exposing aria-pressed for the current theme.
The sun/moon icon that swaps with the active theme; decorative, not the state carrier.

dos: Persist the reported theme through onChange so the choice survives reloads.
Initialize from the system preference when no choice is stored.
Keep one toggle in a consistent location, typically the top bar.
donts: Don't render several toggles that can disagree about the document state.
Don't toggle theme without updating the dark class contract your styles rely on.
Don't bury the toggle in a menu where theme switching is frequent.

examples.title: Light and dark
examples.description: aria-pressed reflects the current theme; persisting the choice stays with the app.

examples.title: Persisted preference
examples.description: onChange reports the new theme so the app shell can store it.

examples.title: Persisting choice
examples.description: Store the theme in onChange and reapply the class on load.

guidance.useWhen: The app offers a light and dark theme switch.
guidance.behavior: Toggles the dark class on the document root and reports state through aria-pressed.

keyboard.action: Toggles between the light and dark theme.

notes: aria-pressed carries the current theme state; the icon swap is decorative.
Initialize from prefers-color-scheme when no stored choice exists so the control starts in sync.

apiEntries.description: Toggles the 'dark' class on the document root to switch between light and dark themes.

props.description: Accessible label for the button; defaults to 'Toggle dark mode'.
props.name: label

props.description: Called with the new theme after toggling; the app is responsible for persisting it.
props.name: onChange
